translation.id: Dengan menyebut nama-Mu, ya Allah! Aku mati dan dan hidup.
translation.en: In Your name, O Allah, I die and I live.

body.id: Rujukan warisan: HR. al-Bukhari. Catatan ini belum diverifikasi dan bukan sumber terstruktur.
body.en: Legacy citation: HR. al-Bukhari. This note is unverified and is not a structured source reference.

benefits.id: Dahulu nabi shallallahu 'alaihi wa sallam senantiasa memulai dan mengakhiri harinya dengan berdzikir.
benefits.en: The Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, would begin and end his day with remembrance of Allah.
